_comment: omni-queue ruleset template for the queue's OWN refs (docs/ops/OMNI_QUEUE.md): the state branch and the candidate branches. Applied by scripts/merge-queue/apply-ruleset.mjs --kind queue-refs, which fills the App bypass actor_id from --app-id. Only the queue's GitHub App may create, update or delete these refs; nobody can rewrite their history. Keys starting with '_' are stripped before the REST call. The candidate pattern is omni-queue/**/* and must stay so: in GitHub's ruleset patterns a trailing ** matches ONE path segment only, and candidate refs have two (omni-queue/<base>/<batchId>-<sha12>), so omni-queue/** left them unprotected (measured against GitHub on 2026-11-15).
name: omni-queue refs protection
